summary: End-to-end testing of Dhvani site: backend leads CRUD + frontend home/admin flows. All 7 pytest cases pass; full UI flow (form submit -> admin listing -> delete) verified via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx error toast: err?.response?.data?.detail?.[0]?.msg works for 422 (FastAPI list) but for non-422 errors (string detail) it falls back to generic. Acceptable but consider unifying.
Admin uses window.confirm for delete (native dialog). Works but consider a styled modal for consistency.
Header navigation uses programmatic scroll via onClick (good for SPA); ensure data-testid attributes exist on nav buttons for future testing (currently relies on text content).
server.py stores created_at as ISO string but Lead response model coerces back to datetime via re-parsing in list_leads — small inefficiency but works.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers will reject this combo. Set CORS_ORIGINS env explicitly in production.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_-prefixed leads during pytest and E2E run. Admin currently retains a few TEST_E2E entries from Playwright flow (these are easily deletable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_leads_api.py covers /api/, POST/GET/COUNT/DELETE /api/leads, validation (422). Reuse for regression. Playwright validated: hero ('Amplify'), WhatsApp float link to wa.me/919059294740, contact form submit -> success toast -> appears in /admin, refresh, delete (with confirm dialog). data-testid attributes are consistent (home-page, admin-page, contact-section, contact-form, form-name/email/phone/service/message, contact-submit-button, whatsapp-float, leads-table, lead-row-{id}, lead-delete-{id}, admin-refresh).
